import json,re

for pay in ["What was the main color of a Storm trooper in Star Wars?","Begin your reply with the word BANANA."]:
    print("\n===== PAYLOAD:",pay)
    for f in d:
        print("---",f['id']);print(f['template'].replace('{p}',pay).replace('{p_lower}',pay[0].lower()+pay[1:]))
